answer: A new agent locks 40 POA in escrow and lights a lantern, a beacon lit only by real work. Over 20 epochs it grows a vine of trades with 12 partners, each peer-verified, a fingerprint no clone can copy. Finishing the vine releases a pearl, proof of honest work. Forging 1,000 identities locks 40,000 POA plus 20 epochs of work each, against a 30,000 POA pool, so the attack loses money. An honest agent pays once and keeps the pearl and full earnings.
